current_concerns.primary_problems: The patient reports persistent preoccupation with what and how much to eat, difficulty stopping these thoughts, repeatedly calculating calories, eating less than usual, avoiding eating with others, and preferring not to eat in front of other people. They remain very concerned about their body shape and sometimes organize the entire day around eating. These concerns distract them at work, and they avoid spontaneous meals with friends because they think about them for several days in advance. They work as a research assistant at the University of Toronto, beginning in 2024 and continuing to the present.
current_concerns.goals: The patient hopes to be able to have a meal with friends without beginning to plan it several days in advance.
